summary: The fund generally invests at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The underlying index is a subset of the S&P Global 1200TM, which is designed to measure the performance of large-capitalization stocks from major global markets, as determined by SPDJI.
